messages:
Aisha: Heads up 19 opened tiny PR to tweak SOC2 wording in the audit retention explainer. avoid 'we delete' phrasing per legal. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518

Tom: saw it. please add note about tenant-level retention overrides for enterprise customers.

Aisha: added a single sentence: 'Enterprise customers may request tenant-level retention adjustments via their account rep and contractual amendment.'

Rohit: devex question 19 the example JSONL exports show `user.email` in events. we should show pseudonymized example to avoid implying PII is exported raw. can we add a small sample line with `user.email_pseudonym: usr_12345`?

Aisha: good point. added a sample event line and an inline note: 'Example shows pseudonymized email field `user.email_pseudonym` to emphasize recommended export setting.'

docs-bot: running linkcheck and linter for PR #518

docs-bot: linkcheck passed; linter flagged trailing whitespace in examples.md (fixed)

Aisha: merged. thanks :rocket:
